caption: The drawing features a round bowl with an ornate, decorative handle attached to the top edge. The bowl and handle are rendered in shades of gray pencil on a light beige or off-white background. The handle has a symmetrical design with cut-out sections and curved elements. The bowl is centrally positioned within a rectangular border drawn in pencil. In the lower right corner of the rectangular border, there is a smaller inset technical drawing showing a side view of the bowl with dimensions indicated. Below the rectangular border, the name "Charles Cullen" is written in script. The overall composition centers the bowl and handle, with the technical detail placed to the lower right and the signature directly below the main drawing.
title: Pewter Porringer
